subject: Startups
title: Twitch: Justin.tv to Gaming
description: A fast breakdown of Twitch: Justin.tv to Gaming for builders.

hook.text: Justin.tv started in 2007 as a site that livestreamed one guy's life 24/7. It was a novelty that wore off fast.

buildup.text: The platform opened to all users. Most streams flopped—except one category that kept growing: video gaming.

discovery.text: The team noticed gamers were passionate, consistent, and brought huge audiences. Gaming was the killer use case.

twist.text: They shut down Justin.tv and relaunched as Twitch, focused entirely on game streaming.

climax.text: Amazon bought Twitch for $970 million in 2014. A reality TV experiment became the world's livestreaming giant.

punchline.text: One man's reality show became everyone's gaming channel.

quiz.question: What was Twitch before it focused on gaming?
options: A general livestreaming platform called Justin.tv
